trusted_faq_corpus.text: SMF (Singapore Manufacturing Federation) helps manufacturing member companies adopt AI. Members can ask this assistant about grants, AI-adoption programmes, ROI expectations, case studies and SMF events.

The Enterprise Development Grant (EDG) supports SMEs adopting new technology including AI. It can co-fund up to 50% of qualifying project costs for eligible Singapore-registered companies. Members apply through the Business Grants Portal.
The Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) supports adoption of pre-approved IT solutions and equipment, including selected AI tools, at up to 50% funding support for eligible SMEs.

AI Solution Day is an SMF event where solution providers showcase AI tools to member companies. Members are matched to relevant sessions based on their stated problem areas such as quality inspection, demand forecasting, or predictive maintenance.
AI Training Day is an SMF event offering hands-on AI upskilling for member-company staff. Topics range from AI awareness for management to practical tool usage for engineers.

To estimate ROI, SMF's assistant considers the member's problem area, chosen driver (revenue, productivity or innovation) and matches partner case studies to preview expected payback. ROI previews are indicative, not guaranteed, and should be validated with an SMF consultant.

A typical case study: a metal-stamping SME deployed computer-vision defect detection and reduced manual inspection effort by about 70%, improving throughput. Results vary by company and are provided as guidance only.

Predictive maintenance uses machine sensor data to forecast equipment failure before it happens, reducing unplanned downtime. It is a common first AI project for manufacturers with connected machinery.
Members who are unsure where to start should describe their operations, KPIs and pain points. The assistant will suggest a shortlist of AI use cases ranked by expected value and feasibility.

For account-specific issues, grant eligibility confirmation, or to speak to a human, members can contact the SMF membership team via the official SMF website contact page. The assistant cannot process payments or approve grants.
Data privacy: members should not share sensitive personal data in the chat. The assistant only provides general guidance and does not store confidential business documents.
SMF membership gives access to industry networks, government-grant guidance, training, and matchmaking with technology solution providers across the Singapore manufacturing ecosystem.
